HOST_BLURB: Hosting VALORA since 2022. Built the space to be a calm Okanagan retreat for friends, families, and small groups — happiest when guests find their own quiet corner of the deck.

REVIEWS.body: We were a group of nine and VALORA had room to spread out. The pool kept the kids happy from sunrise. Shyla was a thoughtful host.
Vaulted ceilings, the brick fireplace at night, and the deck for morning coffee. Quiet street, easy drive to wineries. Already planning a return.
A premium, calm space. Loved the warm wood finishes. The location is genuinely peaceful — felt private in the best way.
